channel.title: Waka Huia
channel.desc: For over 100 years Mataatua wharepuni was uprooted from its home soil in Whakat?ne, over 100 years in which Ng?ti Awa could not be there to keep its fires burning. Ng?ti Awa still mourns. Let the ancestral carvings of the house that came home arise! Arise! (R).
